init.title: Cisco Mobility Express options

data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller is asked for its clients, in seconds (30–300). Increase it on large setups to reduce the load on the controller.
data_description.details_interval: How often the IP address and SSID of each connected client are refreshed, in minutes (1–15). One request covers all clients. Only used on a full WLC; Mobility Express has no effect.
data_description.stale_tracker_age: Disabled trackers of clients not seen for this many days are deleted (1–60). They are recreated, disabled, when the client connects again.
data_description.all_ipv6: Off (default): the ip, ipv4 and SSID attributes come from a single request for all clients. On: each client's detail page is also read for the ipv6 attribute with all IPv6 addresses, including link-local. That costs one extra request per client per refresh, so leave it off on large setups unless you need it.

init.description: Settings that limit the load on the controller. Changes apply immediately, without a restart.
